title: Frequently Asked Questions
desc: Rosenberg Plumbing & Air answers some commonly asked questions about HVAC and plumbing services in the San Antonio area.

items: How often should homeowners in San Antonio schedule HVAC maintenance?Due to long, hot summers, HVAC systems in San Antonio should receive maintenance at least once a year—ideally spring for AC and fall for heating—to prevent breakdowns and maintain efficiency.

What size air conditioner is best for homes in the San Antonio climate?Sizing depends on square footage, insulation, sun exposure, and home layout. A professional load calculation ensures the AC unit is properly sized to handle San Antonio’s high temperatures without overworking.

Why does my air conditioner run constantly during summer in San Antonio?Extremely high outdoor temperatures, low refrigerant, dirty coils, poor insulation, or an undersized unit can cause continuous AC operation. An inspection can pinpoint performance issues.

How can I improve indoor air quality in humid San Antonio weather?Air purifiers, dehumidifiers, proper ventilation, duct cleaning, and high-quality air filters help control allergens, mold, and humidity common in Central Texas homes.

What are the signs of low refrigerant in an AC unit?Warm air, ice on the refrigerant lines, hissing sounds, high humidity, or long cooling cycles can indicate refrigerant leaks—common in older systems in hot climates like San Antonio.

Why do I have uneven cooling in different rooms of my home?Duct leaks, improper duct design, blocked vents, aging systems, or poor insulation often cause uneven cooling, especially in multi-story homes in San Antonio’s heat.
What causes frequent drain clogs in San Antonio homes?Hard water, older plumbing materials, root intrusion, grease buildup, and heavily mineralized pipes can lead to persistent drain clogs.

How can I prevent pipe leaks in older San Antonio homes?Regular plumbing inspections, replacing aging galvanized or cast-iron pipes, using water softeners, and monitoring water pressure help prevent leaks and pipe corrosion.

Why does my water heater struggle to keep up during cooler months?Sediment buildup, failing heating elements, an undersized tank, or fluctuating groundwater temperatures can reduce hot water supply as temperatures shift in the San Antonio area.

What are the benefits of tankless water heaters for Texas homeowners?Tankless units provide endless hot water, lower energy usage, and longer lifespan—ideal for homes seeking efficiency and space savings in the warm San Antonio climate.
